messages:
sophie: Quick UX review for the Private/VPC setup wizard 1: compact scan card, copy for local diagnostics, and keyboard focus behavior. Prototype link: https://figma.com/file/def456 (frame 'Compact-scan-flow'). Thoughts?

kevin: Love the compact card. Two accessibility issues: status badges rely on color only, and the progress spinner has no accessible label. Add icon + text and aria-label on the spinner.

anya: Microcopy suggestion: instead of 'Local scan (transient)' use 'Local diagnostics (won't save settings)'. It's clearer to non-infra folks.

ux-research: From the usability tests, users prefer verbs in CTAs. Replace 'Run' with 'Start scan' and 'Run extended checks' -> 'Start extended scan'. Also testers were confused by the 'CIDR required' phrasing. Suggest helper: 'You can enter a single IP or a CIDR range (e.g., 198.51.100.7 or 198.51.100.0/24)'.

sophie: Good call. Also want to reduce noise: show a compact one-line summary when tests are running: 'Scanning network... 3 checks in progress' and expand to full timeline after completion. Keyboard users should be able to expand with Enter/Space.

kevin: For keyboard focus, after you press Start scan focus should move to the compact summary heading (role="status" or aria-live="polite"). That way screen readers get immediate feedback that the scan started.

anya: We introduced a small 'Last success' chip. Make it tooltipable (hover and focus) and expose timestamp with aria-label 'Last successful scan: 12m ago'. Don't rely on color to indicate recency.

qa-bot: Test note: flaky on staging when probe-eu.staging returns 502 intermittently. Add retry guidance in the UI: 'Retry or try the EU probe (staging)'.

infra-bot: FYI: probes accept TLS on 443 and alternative 8443 in prod. For staging use https://probe-eu.staging.redwood.ai/ping. If you need a one-time upload token for offline diagnostics, open ticket INF-901.

kevin: Copy for failure states: avoid vague 'failed' messages. Use actionable copy: e.g., 'DNS lookup failed  Check that the endpoint host resolves from your VPC or add an explicit host entry.' Provide 'See full diagnostic' link for full trace.

anya: UX polish: collapse 'Advanced network checks' into a disclosure chevron, show a one-line last-run status when collapsed: 'Advanced checks: last run 4m ago, 2 issues'. Keep collapsed by default for new users.

sophie: Implementation question: do we persist the 'Local diagnostics' opt-in? We want it ephemeral by default. It should not be stored unless user toggles 'Save this config' explicitly.

ux-research: User mental model: they expect scans to be non-destructive. Labeling should reflect that. Consider checkbox with 'Save results to this setup' only shown after scan completes.

kevin: Small accessibility requirement: the expanded diagnostic panel needs keyboard trapping for focusable controls inside (close button, copy link, save checkbox). Use a visible focus ring and skip-link maybe.

anya: Example helper snippet for customers to validate egress from their host (include in help panel):
```bash
# run from a host inside your VPC to confirm egress to our probe
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://probe-us.redwood.ai/ping
```
Include note: '200 OK indicates successful TLS handshake and HTTP reachability.'

qa-bot: Also add an automated client-side checksum on pasted CIDR items to catch malformed ranges and show inline error 'Invalid CIDR: expected format x.x.x.x or x.x.x.x/nn'.

infra-bot: Reminder: for customers behind strict egress, we can provide an offline upload token. Add a KB link in the UI: 'Can't egress? Use offline diagnostic.'

kevin: Design nit: the compact card should show results using icons + short phrase: e.g., green check icon + 'Egress OK', orange warn icon + 'High latency', red x + 'Blocked: TCP 443'. That avoids long sentences in the collapsed state.

anya: We debated labels: header options were 'Scan summary', 'Network quick check', 'Connectivity snapshot'. I prefer 'Connectivity snapshot' since it's brief and implies brevity.

sophie: Hmm divergent opinions. Let's A/B 'Connectivity snapshot' vs 'Network quick check' in the prototype. I'll wire both headings and add telemetry.

kevin: Finally, perf: debounce the Start scan button to avoid double-submits (common in the lab when people click twice). Show a disabled state with spinner and aria-busy true.

anya: I'll run a short 5-person hallway test on the two headings and the 'Local diagnostics' label tomorrow. Will report back with preferences and any new accessibility catches.

sophie: Thanks all  I'll update the figma frames with the aria-live, focus target, and collapsed summary states. design-bot, please export the annotated frames for dev.
\

design-bot: Exported frames: Compact-scan-a11y + Compact-scan-collapsed. Notes added: "#compact-summary role=status, aria-live=polite, Start scan moves focus to #compact-summary-heading". Link: https://figma.com/file/def456?node-id=88.

infra-bot: Added probe endpoints to the staging doc. Also test-only probe: https://probe-us.staging.redwood.ai/ping. Use for QA only.

anya: Great, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
